title: Touring bike build
transcript:
# Touring bike build

Budget €2,400 all in.

## Frame

Lugged steel from Porto (Bruno's guy). Deposit €400.

## Parts

- [x] Brooks saddle (have one)
- [ ] Dynamo hub
- [ ] Racks, front and rear
- [ ] Bar-end shifters — Pieter-Jan has a spare set

**Pros:** it will last forever.
**Cons:** it will take forever.

expect.note: Headings + checklist + a mid-note `**Pros:**` that must NOT read as a speaker turn (SpeakerTranscript rule).
